sources.reviewedEvidence: Search-indexed pages 91-93 cover common monomial/binomial factors, distributive factoring and sign normalization; pp.96-98 cover difference of squares including extracting a factor first; pp.99-100 cover sum/difference square patterns and checking the middle coefficient. Indexed pp.118-121 transition into solving quadratic equations, treated as A-8-6 and excluded here.
sources.limits: Shared page is marked All Rights Reserved and is not an official publisher-hosted copy. Used the public indexed lesson excerpts as allowed by the user; no wording, exercise, answer, image or layout reproduced.

sources.material: Public student notes by Manto Teacher, identified as Kanghsuan Grade 8 Volume 3, published 2025-10-31.
sources.reviewedEvidence: The chapter index distinguishes 3-1 common-factor factoring, 3-2 multiplication formulas and 3-3 cross multiplication. Indexed pages 1-8 show divisibility/remainder interpretation, common binomial extraction, sign reversal, exponent rules and repeated extraction; pages 9-12 show cross multiplication, including a leading coefficient other than one and its cross-term sum.
sources.limits: Student-authored notes, not publisher-authenticated textbook text. Used only as a public version-labeled learning-source; original lesson language and examples are new.

sources.material: Publisher-hosted 112-version Grade 8 textbook and remedial GO learner workbook search-index excerpts.
sources.reviewedEvidence: The indexed workbook separates section 3-1 (factor/multiple, monomial/common/sign-changing common factors, difference of squares and perfect-square identity; pp.119-126 locators) from 3-2 cross multiplication (leading coefficient one/non-one and mixed identities; pp.131-138). The textbook index identifies chapter 3 and its 3-2 self-assessment.
sources.limits: Direct PDF open returned HTTP 403 in this browsing environment. Findings are restricted to readable search-indexed text and page locators; no claim is made that unindexed pages were downloaded or fully read.

sources.reviewedEvidence: The NAER math curriculum handbook defines A-8-5 as common-factor extraction, multiplication identities and cross multiplication. Its public teaching transcript derives the cross term as the sum of two diagonal products and checks head, tail and middle terms; this is scope/method evidence, not publisher evidence.

sharedCore: Scan coefficients, variable powers and shared binomials before selecting an identity.
Normalize opposite-sign common binomials and re-evaluate the remaining expression after every extraction.
Check complete-square middle terms and cross-multiplication head, tail and diagonal sum; verify the entire product.
differences: Nani-labeled handout makes sign reversal/repeated extraction and then square identities visible as successive moves; equation solving occurs in later pages and was excluded.
Kanghsuan-labeled notes connect divisibility and remainders to common factors, then show exponent/repeated factoring and cross-product representation.
Hanlin's official resource indexing separates 3-1 common-factor/identity work from 3-2 cross multiplication and grades the latter from monic to non-monic quadratics.
synthesis.originalLessonDesign: Rewrote the lesson around a tile-wall repair inspection: coefficient-variable-binomial scan, sign normalization, reclassification after each extraction, complete-square tests and a fully worked non-monic cross-multiplication example. Added a counterexample where head/tail products match but the cross sum has the wrong sign.
